element_type_count: Count the visible {target_element_plural}. How many are there?
What is the total number of {target_element_plural}?
element_color_count: How many {target_color_label} {target_element_plural} are on the fixture?
Count the {target_color_label} {target_element_plural}. How many are there?
What is the number of {target_color_label} {target_element_plural} on the surface?
Looking across the fixture, how many {target_element_plural} are {target_color_label}?
element_state_count: How many {target_state_label} {target_element_plural} are on the fixture?
Count the {target_element_plural} that are {target_state_label}. How many are there?
What is the number of {target_state_label} {target_element_plural} on the surface?
Looking across the fixture, how many {target_element_plural} are {target_state_label}?
How many visible {target_element_plural} have the {target_state_label} state?
scoped_element_color_count: Count the {target_color_label} {target_element_plural} in {scope_phrase}. How many are there?
In {scope_phrase}, what is the number of {target_color_label} {target_element_plural}?
Looking only at {scope_phrase}, how many {target_element_plural} are {target_color_label}?
empty_or_missing_cell_count: How many missing {target_element_plural} positions are on the fixture?
Count the empty positions where {target_element_plural} are missing. How many are there?
What is the number of missing {target_element_plural} positions?
Looking across the fixture grid, how many {target_element_plural} spaces are empty?
How many visible fixture positions are missing a {target_element_name}?
adjacent_to_reference_count: How many {target_element_plural} share an edge with the uniquely colored {reference_color_label} {target_element_name}?
Count the {target_element_plural} directly edge-adjacent to the {reference_color_label} {target_element_name}. How many are there?
What is the number of {target_element_plural} that touch the {reference_color_label} {target_element_name} by an edge?
Looking at the {reference_color_label} {target_element_name}, how many neighboring {target_element_plural} share an edge with it?
How many {target_element_plural} are immediately above, below, left, or right of the {reference_color_label} {target_element_name}?

query:element_type_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the number of counted surface elements
query:element_type_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array containing one bounding box [x0, y0, x1, y1] around each counted surface element

query:element_color_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the count as an integer
query:element_color_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array containing one bounding box [x0, y0, x1, y1] around each counted colored surface element

query:element_state_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the count as an integer
query:element_state_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array containing one bounding box [x0, y0, x1, y1] around each counted surface element in the requested state

query:scoped_element_color_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the count as an integer
query:scoped_element_color_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array containing one bounding box [x0, y0, x1, y1] around each counted colored surface element in the requested row or column

query:empty_or_missing_cell_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the count as an integer
query:empty_or_missing_cell_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array containing one bounding box [x0, y0, x1, y1] around each missing fixture position

query:adjacent_to_reference_count.answer_hint: set "answer" to the count as an integer
query:adjacent_to_reference_count.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to an array containing one bounding box [x0, y0, x1, y1] around each counted element that shares an edge with the reference element
